Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Travel insurance documents
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Power adapter (if needed)

Clothing:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals/flip-flops
- Hat/cap for sun protection
- Sunglasses

Beach & Water Activities:
- Beach towel
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion/aloe vera
- Beach bag
- Waterproof watch

Hiking & Outdoor Activities:
- Hiking shoes/boots
- Moisture-wicking socks
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Quick-dry t-shirts
- Rain jacket (for unexpected showers)
- Daypack/backpack
- Water bottle/hydration system
- Insect repellent

Health & Personal Care:
- Prescription medications
- Basic first aid kit
- Motion sickness medication
- Hand sanitizer
- Toiletries
- Lip balm with SPF
- Hair ties/clips

Electronics:
- Phone
- Camera
- Portable power bank
- Headphones
- Laptop/tablet (if needed for work)

Activities Specific Items:
- June 11: Waikiki Beach - Beach toys, cooler
- June 12: Hanauma Bay Snorkeling - Underwater camera
- June 13: Diamond Head Hiking - Trekking poles, trail map
- June 14: Pearl Harbor - Respectful attire
- June 15: North Shore Road Trip - Car snacks, playlist
- June 16: Polynesian Cultural Center Luau - Semi-formal attire
- June 17: Hotel Spa Day - Robe (if not provided), slippers
- June 18: Kailua Beach Kayaking - Water shoes, dry bag
- June 19: Ala Moana Shopping - Reusable shopping bags

Miscellaneous:
- Travel guidebook/map
- Notebook and pen
- Reusable water bottle
- Snacks for travel days
- Laundry bag
- Small daypack for excursions
